name: Personal interactions
goal: Personal interactions is a crucial aspect of a group project and is quite often an overlooked concept. When interacting with others, you want to respect them, careful not to hurt their feelings. In peer reviews as well as 'simple' interactions as conversations or requests, professionalism is important.

approach.text: <<source van Dijk, B. (2000). Beinvloed anderen, begin bij jezelf (2nd ed.). Thema>>

normalLearnings: I am able to adjust my own behavior towards other people to maintain a positive attitude while influencing their standpoint or behavior (though there is no endpoint).
I am capable of identifying people's behavior (though there is no endpoint).
result: Once I started to adjust my own behavior, in particular in interactions between me and individuals in the group, their behavior changed as well. I (and others) improved cohesion in the group and the general attitude towards each other.
contribution: This research was mainly focused on problems which were easy to solve, with just a few discussions and improvements. Next, I will apply these methods on bigger problems and challenges within the group.
